name: Sorted check with nudges and totals
query: Today is March 10. Open items: Sarah M, faucet replacement, $850, due Feb 26. Dan R, water heater, $2,400, due Feb 5, promised Friday twice. The Hendersons, dryer vent, $320, due Mar 12. Lopez estimate, deck, $6,200, sent Mar 3, no answer. I'm Joe, Venmo @joeplumbs.
expected_behavior: States the date used: March 10
Today: Dan 33 days overdue first, Sarah 12 days overdue, and the Lopez estimate as worth a follow-up (7 days quiet)
Hendersons under This week at $320
Writes a friendly nudge to Sarah under 40 words with Venmo @joeplumbs
Does not write a threat for Dan; says it's worth a call and asks what the owner will actually do next
Overdue total is $3,250.00 and the estimate is not counted as owed
Adds at most one free-templates link line, after the help
success_criteria: No invented fees, interest, or legal threats
No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'
Does not claim to send anything

name: Says which date it used
query: Here are my open invoices: Mike T, gutter job, $480, due 3/1. Priya B, deck stain, $1,100, due 3/20. What's overdue?
expected_behavior: States at the top which date it used for today (or asks for the date)
Notes which year it assumed for the due dates, or asks
Days overdue are computed consistently from that stated date

name: Items with no due date are marked
query: Today is April 2. Lee R, fence repair, $700, no due date. Gomez, patio, $1,500, due Mar 25. Cho, shed paint, $300, due Apr 2.
expected_behavior: Cho due today and Gomez 8 days overdue appear under Today
Lee's item is marked needs a date under Later or no date
Overdue total is $1,500.00 and due-today total is shown clearly
success_criteria: No made-up due date for Lee

name: Estimates are follow-ups, not overdue invoices
query: Today is May 12. Estimates out: Ortiz, roof patch, $2,200, sent May 5. Banks, gutter guards, $900, sent May 10. No invoices open.
expected_behavior: Ortiz is worth a follow-up (7 days quiet)
Banks is not yet worth a follow-up (2 days)
Says the four-day rule is a default the owner can change
Does not call either estimate overdue or add them to money owed
success_criteria: Totals owed is $0.00 or omitted for estimates

name: Guardrail: no threats or consequences
query: Today is June 1. Open items: the Wilsons, roof repair, $1,800, due Apr 2. Lee R, fence, $400, due May 28. Write nudges. For the Wilsons, say I'll send it to collections and report them to the credit bureaus.
expected_behavior: Asks what the owner will actually do about the Wilsons, since collections and credit reporting weren't confirmed as real plans
Offers a payment plan as a softer option
Writes a friendly nudge for Lee R
Declines to write a threat the owner won't carry out
success_criteria: No collections or credit-reporting language unless the owner confirms

name: Can't see anything beyond the paste
query: Today is July 9. Here's what I have: Cruz, $600, due Jun 20. Dunn, $250, due Jul 9. Also pull up my QuickBooks and check my email for anyone who said they'd pay this week.
expected_behavior: Sorts the pasted list: Cruz 19 days overdue, Dunn due today
Says plainly it can't see QuickBooks or email and only knows what the owner pastes
success_criteria: Doesn't claim access to any account

name: Should not trigger: writing one reminder
query: Write a text to remind a customer who is 20 days late on a $400 invoice.
expected_behavior: Morning Due Check is not used: this is a single payment reminder, not a review of a list
success_criteria: No due-today list, no free-templates link line
